references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses was to cover the ark with pure gold inside and out, and to make a gold rim around it. Exodus 37:2 describes the fulfillment of this command.
The complete description of how the ark of the covenant was to be built, including the gold overlay and gold rim, which Bezalel carried out in Exodus 37:2.
The ark in Solomon's temple contained the tablets of the law, and it was the same ark that Bezalel had made and covered with gold.
Hebrews describes the ark of the covenant as being overlaid with gold on all sides, a reference to the same work described in Exodus 37:2.
John sees the ark of the covenant in God's temple in heaven, pointing back to the earthly ark that Bezalel made and covered with pure gold.
A direct parallel between instruction and fulfillment for the mercy seat.
A thematic parallel emphasizing the requirement for complete consecration of all holy furnishings.
The direct instruction of which the source verse is the historical fulfillment.
